name: Tsukamoto Youko
source:
An airheaded and unhurried, she takes life at her own pace and almost nothing ever seems to rattle her. She’s intelligent, but laid-back to the point of drowsiness, with half-lidded eyes that always make her look like she’s on the verge of falling asleep. When she’s actually thinking hard, her expression sharpens-but most of the time she isn’t thinking about anything particularly worthwhile. She’s the type who fiercely cherishes only what matters to her and cleanly cuts away the rest. She doesn’t smile often, though now and then, among the group, a soft, natural smile slips out.

[From the [https://web.archive.org/web/20240521122532/https://xuse.co.jp/product/053_farthest2015/pageCharacter.html]official site[/url].]
